title: The Grand Terrace show the band couldn't read
summary: The band failed the Grand Terrace show because several men could not read, causing complaints from the other acts.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Now, another thing I think at the Grand Terrace of course, you go to play the show there.
Well that was a problem wasn't it? (LAUGHTER).
We didn't make it. Oh, we messed that show up something terrible.
What happens when you I mean in a case that like that where the band really can't play the show? What......

All the artists went to the, went to the Fox and told him. And they were right, we couldn't play. That was the worst engagement I think that we ever had. We could play dance music, but when it came to reading parts, that's when we found out we had these guys in the band that couldn't read. So then Basie started changing. But it wasn't, we never did get much complaints for playing swing, dance music. Just from those shows where you had to read.
